additional_experiments.scope: Exploratory timing and FP64 checks on measured inputs; rejected pipeline prototypes are not release-qualified. Full samples and source snapshots are retained with raw evidence.

dv_before_dp.conclusion: No complete-call improvement over the selected schedule.

packed_fp32_statistics.conclusion: The long causal D128 bundle motivated the smaller final implementation; use the independent incremental comparison for final-source gains.

launch_option_carveout.limitation: Function attributes retained their default; captured launch-hint propagation was not established. Explicit graph-node tests follow.

dedicated_loader_pipeline.conclusion: No consistent complete-call gain across the measured important cases justified retaining the producer/consumer implementation.

sustained_telemetry.scope: Separate sustained BF16 B1/H16/S4096 forward plus all gradients; four20-second passes per case, first5seconds excluded from summaries; 100 graph replays per CUDA event sample; 200ms whole-board telemetry; no profiler. D16 dense/causal and D128 causal.

controls_note: D16/D64 short calls are unchanged controls. D512 retains its first-round selection, with no additional preservation gate.
